title: Unit Event — Immiscible Discord

meta.Outline: Watched closely by her mother, Mafuyu's interaction with N25 continues to be limited. Focusing on what she can still do for her friend, Kanade is driven to keep composing, until she receives a mysterious message...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Okay, I was right to lower the bass for this. The melody sounds much better now.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And it should go with Mafuyu's lyrics.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What? Already?
Can't you stay for a little longer?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm done with what I needed to do today. Also, I don't want my mom to worry...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But I plan on logging in early tomorrow to keep working...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Okay...
Then, I'll try to finish my demo a little early.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, I just have a few adjustments left to make.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Okay, I'll be looking forward to hearing it...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu seems to be most at ease whenever she's creating music with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I still haven't been able to compose a song that can save Mafuyu.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But if the time we spend together creating music really does put her at ease...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'll keep trying. Because I'm definitely going to someday...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll see you...
Oh, you have bags under your eyes.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Did you stay up late studying last night? Please don't push yourself too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
Time really flew by since I had so much fun solving all those problems.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I promise to get some rest tonight.
Anyway, I need to get going.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I want to try my hand at music...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: (It'll be too late by the time she begins regretting her decision...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: It's not in this folder either...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I was sure that she'd have all of her music data saved somewhere, but I'm not seeing anything...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
But Mafuyu's a clever girl...
She may've hidden it somehow.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: From what I remember, there's a way to hide folders and such. So, I'll keep looking a little more...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
This folder contains...
Illustrations and... Lyrics? Oh...?

rows.Speaker: Chat
rows.Line:
<I'm logging off now. I'll upload my work-in-progress illustrations.>
<My storyboards are done too. Take a look at them when you can, okay?>
<Thank you both. I'll look at them later.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: (I didn't know she was using anything like this... Is she using this to communicate with these people about music and such...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: She sent this message at... One in the morning?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Did you stay up late studying last night? Please don't push yourself too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
Time really flew by since I had so much fun solving all those problems.

rows.Speaker: K
rows.Line:
<The new demo's done.
Let us know if you think you can work today, Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I see. This person must be the songwriter...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (He still doesn't seem to know who I am...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I'm glad we got to talk today...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll continue working on that song when I get home...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's nice that I got the demo out of the way too. Mafuyu should be home soon and...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(This friend request...
Who sent it? Did they mark the wrong recipient...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, there's a message. Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line:
<Dear K,
I apologize for contacting you so suddenly.>

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <I am Yuki's mother. I see that you've been creating music with her and I am here to make a request regarding that.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Why does she know about my account...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Hang on... Mafuyu said that her mom's been trying to see what's going on with her computer.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It probably won't lead to anything good... That might lead to Mafuyu being bombarded with questions by her mom and feeling even worse as a result...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Nice to meet you. This is K. I am the main composer for “Nightcord at 25:00”. I always enjoy working with Yuki on our music.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <May I ask what this request of yours is?>

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <Allow me to get straight to the point.>

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <I would like for you and Yuki to stop working on this music of yours.>

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <Of course, I understand that it's important to have a hobby to help take one's mind off things.>

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <However, she hasn't been sleeping much lately, and I'm worried about her well-being.>

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <She is in pursuit of a different dream that doesn't involve music. If you truly are her friend, I'm sure you'd want her to focus on her studies.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Wait... What is her dream...?
I've never asked before...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But if she is pursuing a dream that I don't know about...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line: We were assigned to write an essay the other day.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line:
And the theme was “My Dream Job”...
So, I wrote that I wanted to become a composer just like you.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line: Yes! My teacher even said that I probably could since my grades for music are always so good.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
I see...
I feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: But you'll need to keep your grades up in your other subjects as well.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Kanade
rows.Line: But... Wouldn't it be better to spend that time composing songs? I don't know what social studies and biology have to do with music...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Haha. Don't say that. The worldlier you are, the wider your musical horizons will be as a composer.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: There are times when I wish I studied more when I was still in school.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Yes. So, if you do wish to become a composer, you should try to learn as much as you can.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: I'm sure it'll help you in life.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I understand what Mafuyu's mom is trying to say...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's true that now is a crucial time in her life...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Okay, I'll be looking forward to hearing it...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm sorry, but I don't think I'm in a position to ask her to do that.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <As long as Yuki wishes to create music with us, I'd like to keep working with her.>

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <Even if there's a chance that it places her future in jeopardy?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Again, I'm in no position to ask her to stop as long as she wishes to continue working with us.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This should be what's best for Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <You seem to be misunderstanding me slightly, so how would you feel about us meeting in person?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I think I'll work a little before I get to studying.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Kanade said that she'd have her demo ready by the evening, so I'll just take my computer out of my desk and...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Um, Mom...?
Did you use my computer today?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, there was something I needed to look up. I apologize for not asking you first.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, that's okay...
It's fine, but...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Would you mind not using it anymore?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Um, so... If you end up accidentally overwriting an important file or something...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I mean... I know you'd never do that, but my homework's on there. If that were to disappear, I'd be in big trouble...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Are those poems also a part of your homework...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Mafuyu...
Why don't you stop staying up so late each night to study?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You haven't been getting enough sleep lately. I doubt you'll be able to absorb much without proper rest.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Or is it that you have something else on your mind while you do...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Because you know what you have to do in order to make your dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She probably knows about N25, the others... Everything...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What do I do...? What can I do...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I still want to make music with the others... With N25...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I don't want to give up music...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Because you know what you have to do in order to make your dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She's worried about me... She wants what's best for me... She says that she does...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And everybody had lots and lots of fun playing together...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I really like this picture book Ena brought over...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Kanade and the others must be working on their latest song. I wonder what it's going to be like...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to listening to it...
So, you're the Miku of this SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This...is an empty SEKAI, I see.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There was nothing here at first.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But now, Mafuyu has me, Kanade and the others...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Mafuyu, is it...? This SEKAI belongs to her?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, she's the one who called me here...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (If Mafuyu did in fact call for KAITO to come here...)

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <She is in pursuit of a different dream that doesn't involve music. If you truly are her friend, I'm sure you'd want her to focus on her studies.>

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <Even if there's a chance that it places her future in jeopardy?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I can't honestly say if N25 will help her achieve her dream...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But Mafuyu currently seems to want to keep making music with us...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Not only that, but I'm sure our work will help lead us to discovering who the real Mafuyu is.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (So, right now, I really don't want her to give up music or stop making it...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line:
<Oh, then let's go on voice chat!
Is K also here?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, it's already 25:00...
I should unmute myself and...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Hi, K.
I listened to the new demo. It's really good.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you. I'm hoping that it helps Yuki with her work a little...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<What's wrong?
You don't sound very happy.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, Yuki! Wasn't K's new demo amazing?! I can't wait to make the video for it!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I don't think we'll be able to work together for a while...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I can keep writing lyrics and such...
But I doubt I'll be able to log on.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Wait, what do you mean?
I thought you had everything hidden.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I did...
But she must've found it while looking around inside my computer when I was out...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I have to think that she also found my lyrics and Nightcord...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <So, did she tell you to stop...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Mafuyu's mom definitely said something to her.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (If we don't do something, Mafuyu might...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But she isn't making you stop, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're really okay with this? Honestly, you...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I won't be able to join you all for a while.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <However, I don't know when that's going to be...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Thank you for the demo...
It may take me longer than usual, but I promise to write the lyrics for it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <She said her mom was just “looking around”, but I've gotta think she was trying to find us...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Remember how I took Mafuyu over to my house that other time? She asked me...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <“Mafuyu mentioned a friend who plays music. Is that you?”>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <She's been keeping what we do a secret from her mom, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That's probably why she began looking for who her daughter is playing or making music with...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I know you're worried about Mafuyu.
So are we...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<No, it's not that...
I mean, I am worried... But...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sorry, I was hoping to discuss that with you today...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<But Mafuyu's mom...?
What's going on here? Can you tell us what she said?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<So...
She asked me to stop working on music with Mafuyu.>

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <She is in pursuit of a different dream that doesn't involve music. If you truly are her friend, I'm sure you'd want her to focus on her studies.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, what did you say to her?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I said how I'm not in a position to ask her to do that as long as she wishes to keep working with us...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Then, she responded by asking me to meet with her in person...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <This Sunday. So, the day after tomorrow...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <The day after tomorrow... That's so soon! I mean, are you gonna be okay?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I doubt she's going to harm you in any way, but she's been trying to dig up a ton of info on us. Who knows what she's gonna say...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I wasn't sure about meeting her until just now...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I won't be able to join you all for a while.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But I feel that I need to meet her since this directly concerns Mafuyu...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Also, I want to hear what she has to say about us...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I really don't wanna just sit around and wait. I feel like I'm gonna go crazy if I don't give her my two cents...!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I wanna go too. I'm worried sick about Mafuyu...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<But I should be fine on my own.
Please don't worry. I promise to let her know how we all feel...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I know you're worried about Mafuyu, but I don't think it'll be a good idea for you two to come...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<If things don't go well...
I'm concerned that we won't be able to meet Mafuyu anymore.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Which is why I think I should go meet her alone...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <If she learns who you both are, Mafuyu may have no one else to turn to... She'd be all alone...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay... But let us know if anything happens. We'll be there before you know it..>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, because we all want what's best for Mafuyu...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm glad that I got the art supplies I wanted, but I wasn't expecting to walk around for so long...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. We did check out a bunch of different shops to see all the new stuff they just got in.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Still, it was a nice breath of fresh air...
I feel a lot better now. Brooding all alone wouldn't have done either of us any good.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I still sorta can't believe that Kanade's actually going to meet Mafuyu's mom...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You think she's gonna be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'm worried...
I've spoken to her once before on the phone, but I got some really nasty vibes from her...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, how do I put it...?
She seems nice on the outside, but it's like she has to be in control or something...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I get what you mean.
Mafuyu told me about her a while back, but I sorta got the same impression...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which means... Mafuyu's got it even worse...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She really didn't seem to want to go home that other time... If she's forced to quit N25, I have to think it's only going to make her feel worse...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Isn't there anything we can do for her...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But this is a tough one...
It's a family matter, I guess. So, who are we to say anything about Mafuyu's future and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
H-Huh...?
Over there. Isn't that Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It is. She must be on her way back from cram school...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wanna try calling her over...?
She might have some time to talk right now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I don't know if there's much we can do, but if it'll at least help make her feel a little better...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright!
Then, I'll go talk to her! You watch our seats!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Do you have to make such a big fuss?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, did you have cram school today...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay. So, how have things been since yesterday...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, you still haven't ordered anything to drink yet. Mafuyu, what do you want? Also, are you hungry?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'll just have some tea for now...
I'm having dinner later.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay, tea it is!
I might just get something too while we're at it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Me? Oh, the fruit parfait looks really good. I've been craving something sweet.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: A parfait? But you just had a crepe during lunch. Aren't you worried about your figure?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's fine. Today's my cheat day!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Knowing you, that makes every day a cheat day!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Don't you agree with me, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There's nothing wrong with eating what you want.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And I don't need you to tell me that. Mizuki, call someone over already.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, relax. I'll call them over now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But guess what?! This one shop we went to today had these new outfits that would look so great on you and Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! It's nothing like what you two wear on a regular basis, but I want you two you try it on since I bet it'll suit you both really well...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki made a huge fuss about that when we were there too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha! Yeah, I did!
So, Mafuyu, wanna invite Kanade and check it out together the next time we can?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah... We don't know when we'll be able to, but let's set aside some time when we can, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (There's nothing we can do for her right now...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But... I hope we can keep giving her opportunities to not have to think about her family...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (When I was coming home from cram school, my chest felt so cold...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But I feel so much warmer after talking with them.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If only things could stay this way forever...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Because you know what you have to do in order to make your dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I should head home. It's almost curfew...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Are you sure you're gonna be okay, Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, I feel a little better now...
Thank you both very much.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, we've finished eating, so I guess we should head home too...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I had so much fun today.
I hope we get to hang out like this again soon!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know things aren't gonna be easy now that your mom knows about N25, but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You need to speak up if something really bothers you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because you're the only one who can protect yourself in the end...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I have to speak up if something bothers me...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If I'm not allowed to do anything with N25...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If I'm not allowed to make music with them, I...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Mafuyu...
Why don't you stop staying up so late each night to study?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, I need to buy that study guide...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Fancy seeing you here. Are you just on your way home from cram school?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, Dad...
Yes, but I need to go buy a study guide first.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
I see. You're such a studious girl.
Since I'm here, why don't I buy it for you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Okay, you two.
I made your favorite today. Beef stew.
Bon appetit and don't be afraid to ask for seconds.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.
Still, I was surprised to see you both come home together.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you for buying me that study guide, Dad. I promise to put it to good use.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: But you seem to have been staying up late to study recently. It's important to take breaks from time to time, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
That's okay, dear.
I've already spoken to her about that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, it's important to study as much as you can before exams, but you need to rest instead of staying up so late.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You need to speak up if something really bothers you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Being barred from studying at night is...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: S-So, um... It's just... I think I should study whenever I can in preparation for my exams...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The medical school I want to get into is extremely competitive, so I fear that I won't get in if I don't work harder than the other applicants.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Yes, I understand what you're trying to say. Your fellow applicants will surely be studying very hard to get accepted.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Is that really your only reason...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I understand why you feel anxious since everybody is working hard to get accepted, Mafuyu... However, I've also been told that a person's brain digests new information as they sleep.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: So, there wouldn't be much point in studying if you can't actually learn or memorize anything.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Therefore, I believe you should study only when it's light out and sleep when you can.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Ah, I see. I agree with your mother.
Especially since staying up late is bad for your health.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh? Is there more you'd like to say...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But I said that I didn't want to...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If she gets her way and I'm not allowed to do anything with N25...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (This place always helps calm my nerves...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I don't have to think about anything...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is there nothing else I can do...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're really okay with all this...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Tomorrow's the day I meet Mafuyu's mom...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (For Mafuyu's sake, I need to make a good argument...)

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <She is in pursuit of a different dream that doesn't involve music. If you truly are her friend, I'm sure you'd want her to focus on her studies.>

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <Even if there's a chance that it places her future in jeopardy?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I solemnly believe that making songs together as N25 is having a positive effect on Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I can't speak for her dream or her future...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(What if her mom is right...?
What if our work keeps her from studying the way she needs to and prevents her from achieving her dream...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I don't know what the right answer is...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I can't mull this over forever...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Maybe I should try talking to Miku...)
But there's nothing I can do now...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I told her no...!
I said that I didn't want to give up music!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What else can I do at this point...?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If you're willing to give up after just that, then it's obviously not important enough.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But that's not the case, is it?
So quit lying to yourself.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
...!
I'm not lying to myself... I...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Fine, then do whatever you want.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But mark my words.
If you let things be, you'll never know who the “real” you is.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, are you really okay with how things are...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're here because you're not, right? Am I wrong?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If you believe that there's nothing else you can do, then let go of what you're feeling and get on with your life.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My mom...? How am I supposed to do that...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You don't have time to be asking that...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She's doing everything she can to destroy who you really are. How can you even think about showing her any mercy?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She cares about me. She's not trying to...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, come on. Open your eyes.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You know exactly what she's trying to do. But you just keep—

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You went way too far there, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: M-Mafuyu looked like she was in so much pain just now...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You won't get through to her by sugarcoating what you say. I don't plan on babying her like the rest of you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Mafuyu really told her mom that she doesn't want to give up music...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I still don't know what I can say to help Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I really don't know...
But I need to say everything I can for her sake.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I need to tell Mafuyu's mom just how much her daughter is suffering...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's probably all I can do right now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's see... I'm supposed to meet her somewhere around here...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I need to say everything I can.
For Mafuyu's sake...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm sure she cares about Mafuyu very much...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (So I'm hoping that if I can explain to her just how much Mafuyu is suffering over the prospect of not being able to work on music anymore is taking a significant mental toll on her...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Which is why I'm not going to tell any lies or half-truths. I'll tell her what's going on and try to find the best solution I can.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She looks just like Mafuyu. Is she...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, my name is Kanade Yoisaki.
It's been a pleasure working with Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to talking to you today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm Yuki's mother.
Thank you for agreeing to meet with me today, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I apologize for what happened the other day. I may've sounded rather cold due to my not being used to chatting on a computer.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, that didn't bother me...
I'm also not very used to chatting online.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Thank goodness... She seems like a nice person...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Also, Ms. Yoisaki, you know Mafuyu's real name...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, we've met offline...I mean, in real life a few times...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Anyway, we have much to discuss today. Shall we find a place where we can sit and talk?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. There's no need to feel so anxious. You have my word that it's a nice place.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Still, it is a fairly fancy establishment. I also felt a little nervous when I first came here.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But don't worry, I'm sure you'll get used to it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes. So, let's try to have a relaxing time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: We actually always come here as a family to celebrate Mafuyu's various achievements.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, my apologies.
I'm just so excited about having the opportunity to speak with one of Mafuyu's friends that I can't seem to contain my excitement.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Anyway, how does a cake and a drink sound...?
I'd like you to try it since the ones they bake here are very good.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, sure...
Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: When did you first meet Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um... I'd say around two years ago.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I see...
What sorts of things do you usually do with her?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We're in a music group that produces songs. Mafuyu's in charge of writing lyrics for us...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, that.
I'm sorry. I took the liberty of looking at some of her lyrics...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
And your songs are nice.
Making music with friends seems like such a wonderful hobby.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. I listen to classical music quite a lot, but I never thought about creating my own songs. I was so surprised when I first found out that Mafuyu is doing just that...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Isn't it hard to produce the songs that you do?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, um... It really isn't.
But it can be when I don't have any ideas...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But Mafuyu and the others in our group have helped me quite a lot with that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I see.
Hehe. I'm glad to hear that she's been able to help.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But you must all be busy preparing for your own entrance exams. You're all around the same age as Mafuyu, no?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm sure it isn't easy for you to write songs while also going to school, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, um... Not all of us are studying for exams...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That includes myself... I'm not actually studying for any...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Then, you don't plan on pursuing higher education...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, not at the moment...
Music is more important to me than exams right now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I admire the fact that you have something you're so passionate about...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She's taking it much better than I was expecting...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Also, I mentioned this when we chatted before... But, no different from you, Mafuyu's pursuing a big dream.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: To become a doctor. Isn't it wonderful?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(That's Mafuyu's dream...?
I had no idea... But...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I just don't understand. I live my life every day, but nothing gives me pleasure or joy.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yet I can sense that something vital is missing.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <How do I even put this into words?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (In the beginning, Mafuyu wasn't sure what she wanted to do with herself...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (So much so that she wanted to disappear completely...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (If it's true that Mafuyu does want to become a doctor more than anything else, then...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I told her no...!
I said that I didn't want to give up music!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What else can I do at this point...?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This person in front of me is convinced that she cares about Mafuyu... However...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: So, I'd like to ask you once more today regarding Mafuyu's dream in life...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: For her sake, at least until she's finished taking her entrance exams, please refrain from contacting her...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I understand that she needs to study...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I also feel that Mafuyu needs music right now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, I agree that it's important to take breaks from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, but... That's not what I meant...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu told me herself that she doesn't want to give up music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Which is why I'd like for you to allow her to keep working with us. It only has to be when she has some free time on her hands.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Didn't I just say that it's important to take breaks?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Also, I don't plan on forcing her to give up music entirely until she's done taking her exams...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (So, she's not completely against Mafuyu making music with us...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Then, I might actually be able to get somewhere with her. My assumptions about her may've been misplaced...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But I would like for her to stop working with this group of yours...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I don't know much about it, but you have deadlines and such to meet, yes...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: And writing lyrics sounds very time-consuming... If she were able to work at her own pace, then she'd be able to participate without it taking away from her studies...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Also, Mafuyu's so kind that she may be having trouble saying that she'd rather be studying instead of doing anything music-related...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: B-But that won't work for her...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I believe that Mafuyu wants and needs to make music with us... Together!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, what makes you say that...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (How do I tell her that I'm trying to save her...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I understand that not being able to see or talk to Mafuyu anymore is going to be difficult after working with her for these past two years...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But I'd like to take this opportunity to say...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Your little music group...
There is no room in her life for such a thing.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: So, if you truly do care about Mafuyu, you'll ask her to leave your group.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm sure she'll understand if she hears it coming from your mouth.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(She seems to care about Mafuyu...
I can tell that she spends a lot of time thinking about her.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But... Something's wrong. This doesn't feel right...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm used to a different kind of warmth. She just feels...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Anyway, thank you for meeting with me and spending so much time with Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I wish you and your music group the best.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(No, I can't let her go...!
If I don't do something, Mafuyu will...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She told me once that she wanted to disappear...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. Not only that, but she didn't know what she wanted to do with herself...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Right now, I want to keep doing this with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu told me herself that she wants to keep making music with us.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Again, I understand that it's important for her to study, but won't you please allow her to stay in our group?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Please...!
If you take music away from Mafuyu, she's going to...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Is that what she's been telling you...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Of course she did...
She's so kind and polite...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: She must've told you that because something happened at school. Maybe she didn't receive the grade she wanted for a test and is feeling bad about it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Thank you, Ms. Yoisaki.
I appreciate the way you've supported her until now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: However, I'll need to ask her about what's been happening.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If... If you do truly care about Mafuyu's well-being, then please ask her what she actually wants to do... I beg you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: When you do, I'm sure she'll be able to explain why she needs our group right now. Then you'll understand.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, you may see why she's been suffering...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I agree that Mafuyu and I will need to have a little heart to heart...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Which should give her an opportunity to see that she doesn't need your silly, little group and that becoming a doctor is what's best for her.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm sure she'll be back to normal after we've had a chance to talk things over...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She doesn't care at all about Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line:
Yes, Kanade. But I'm so sorry...
We were supposed to go on a picnic together today, but we can't now because of me.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
No, that's okay!
We can go some other time.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: So, once you get all better, we can go together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, I hope we can go see some pretty flowers together again.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Mommy! Are you sure you're okay?
Maybe you should lie down...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: I'm okay. I'll feel much better after I listen to the music box your father gave me.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
Um, Mommy...?
Do you always feel better after listening to Daddy's music box?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
The songs your father writes are so wonderful. They always fill me with so much warmth.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Then, I wanna learn how to write songs like Daddy. That'll make you feel even better, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line:
You shouldn't do it for me...
You should do what you want to do.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Yes. Wanting to learn how to write wonderful songs like your father is a beautiful dream.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: But I'll be happy as long as you find something that makes you happy, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That time, Mom put my interests first...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She doesn't seem to care how Mafuyu actually feels...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but what you're doing isn't right...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You don't seem to understand how Mafuyu feels. If anything, you're trying to suppress who she is...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Mafuyu means the world to me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Ever since she was little, she's been a kind and polite girl... That's why I want to make her the happiest person in the world.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: It saddens me to see that you're misunderstanding my intentions, but I want you to know that I care about her deeply.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(She is her mother...
Because of that, I was sure she'd be able to show a degree of warmth or kindness...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But... I was wrong... Clearly, not all parents are capable of doing that...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(This is bad...
If she has her way, she'll completely destroy Mafuyu.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And then she won't have a choice but to bend to her mother's will...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm not sure how to put what I'm feeling right now into words...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Initially, I was under the impression that you came here to meet with me to explain how you wished for Mafuyu to give up music because you were worried about her...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Everything you've said... Everything I've heard from you... Even though you are in fact Mafuyu's mother...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't believe a word you're saying...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I refuse to leave Mafuyu's side...
Regardless of what you say...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I was hoping that you'd understand if you truly did care about Mafuyu... But I suppose I was wrong as well...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
You should head home soon.
I'd rather not keep your family waiting.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Thank you for meeting with me today, Ms. Yoisaki. I'm glad we had this chance to talk...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: However, I'd like for you to not tell Mafuyu about us meeting today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I wouldn't want it to keep her from studying.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I feel the same way and don't want to increase her burden.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Also, this may feel like unwanted solicitation... But try not to do anything that you'll regret in the future, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But Mafuyu's spent her whole life in that person's cold, uncaring presence...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I need to save her somehow...
But what can I actually do...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That person is never going to change her mind.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (At the same time, Mafuyu still believes in her... Because she desperately wants to...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And yet, at this rate, Mafuyu will...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (All I can do for her right now is keep composing and be ready to welcome her back at any time...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I sort of took it for granted until now, but Mom and Dad showered me with so much affection...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It won't be easy for me to share that with Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But if she ever wants to be away from that person...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's about all I can do for her...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I should try to come up with more that I can do for her...
